corrections.new:
`SigningWindow` (in `mcp-re-http-profile`) keeps `expires` private and no constructor accepts
one: every window is derived as the earlier of the configured TTL from `now` and the
credential's own `exp`, with saturating arithmetic so an absurd configured TTL cannot wrap
past it. A credential already past its bound yields a window claiming no future validity
rather than one running backwards. The delegated signing key is crate-private to its
`ActiveDelegatedKey`, and the emitters that read it take a window, so a signature under a
delegated credential cannot advertise any other validity. The proxy's one opener opens every
window this deployment signs under, reply and refusal alike, and a refusal signs under the
snapshot its own exchange took.
